description: Makes a UGC-style ad from a product and a template or feature (testimonial, talking presenter, product video and others) and returns a job; when it is done the result lists the ad's files as links. Spends the account's credits; the cost depends on the feature and its length, so call ugcfans_estimate first and pass its quote. Without a quote this returns the cost and makes nothing. A presenter must be saved, have a portrait and, for a real person, recorded consent at https://ugc.fans/library.

feature.description: What kind of ad, a slug from ugcfans_search_templates such as testimonial, talking-presenter or product-video.

page_url.description: A web page to read the product from.

person.description: The presenter: the id of a saved person that has a portrait and, for a real person, recorded consent.

images.description: Pictures of it: addresses of library files, out/...

product.description: What is being sold: a sentence, or an object with its name, description and pictures.

quote.description: The quote from ugcfans_estimate for exactly this request. Without it the call returns the estimate and makes nothing.

reviews.description: Real customer reviews a testimonial rests on.

script.description: A script already written, by its id from ugcfans_write_script.

template.description: A template slug from ugcfans_search_templates, which fills in the frame, length and shots.

testimonial_basis.description: Where a testimonial's words come from. verbatim and edited need reviews.

voice.description: The voice: the id of a saved voice.

name: ugcfans_make_ad
title: Make a UGC ad
